ammonia.reason: No proteolysis-driven NH3 accumulation in unaged days-old curd with pH 6.3.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole/skatole not detected in clean pasteurized curd with no rind flora.

bitter.reason: Minimal hydrophobic peptides from chymosin-only coagulation without starter proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: Trace 2-heptanone/2-nonanone ~0.1 mg/kg in fresh vs 42-62 mg/kg after 12 wk, no Penicillium.

browning.reason: High moisture and low free amino acids limit Maillard; only slight color on frying.

buttery.reason: Trace diacetyl 0.94 ug/g and acetoin 1.22 ug/g only in raw-milk versions, ND in starter-free pasteurized.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low C4-C8 free fatty acids butanoic ~1.9 ug/g hexanoic ~4.5 ug/g from minimal lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 20-24% fat in 51-56% moisture gives moist mouthfeel but fragile curd, not creamy.

crumbliness.reason: Starter-free high-pH high-calcium fresh rennet gel fractures into characteristic friable crumble.

firmness.reason: High-moisture fresh rennet gel with intact but fragile casein network, soft to cut.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylethyl alcohol ~0.10 ug/g from phenylalanine catabolism, very low.

fruity.reason: Trace ethyl butanoate ~0.81 ug/g in raw versions ND pasteurized from esterase esterification.

goaty.reason: Low octanoic ~3-4 mg/kg and decanoic acids from milkfat lipolysis, far below goat cheese.

malty_nutty.reason: Trace 3-methylbutanal ~0.31 ug/g from leucine Strecker degradation with no aging.

melt.reason: Intact colloidal calcium phosphate and no proteolysis prevent flow; softens but holds shape.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not detected, no mold lipoxygenase pathway.

oil_off.reason: Homogenized milk fat trapped in fresh protein matrix, minimal free oiling-off on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step, no guaiacol/syringol phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Very low acetic acid ~0.72 ug/g and pH 6.3 with 3.1% residual lactose, no starter acidification.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, no aligned casein fibers for stringing.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low heat load pasteurized 63C and 32C set with no sulfur volatiles detected.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose ~3.1% at pH 6.3 retains milky lactose sweetness.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate/peptides from chymosin-only fresh curd with days of age.
